evidence.locator: Zhong et al.; pinned source utils.py selectivity/reward definitions and frame mapping
evidence.supports: Source stimulus and reward-location selectivity use distinct definitions; source reward-location statistic is not evidence that water was delivered on every category2 trial.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing generated construction controls retain their original engineering scope. No authentic-data model result for this task was established by this inspection; the historical EEG077/sleep007 programme pilot is a separate scope.
excluded_claims: Complete behavior-matched reward coding, causal learning, participant understanding results or authenticated native cohort coverage.

disposition_reason: The evaluator computes real neural selectivity, behavioral-common-support contrasts and held-animal residuals from explicit array packets. It neither authenticates native cohorts nor grades participant investigation answers, and reward-location selectivity remains behavior-unmatched. Narrow the current claim to conditional stimulus-selectivity evidence; retain reward analysis as an unresolved companion.

scientific_target.question: Across paired before/after animals, how do reward-free and rewarded regimes differ in calcium stimulus selectivity on common observed movement-position support, and which reward-location changes remain unexplained by behavioral confounds?
scientific_target.known_answer: Recomputable per-cell d-prime, regional fractions and animal-level before/after contrasts from measured neural arrays; the estimated effect may be null, negative or undefined. Reward-location d-prime is a separate unmatched statistic, not a known reward-coding truth.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Calcium-derived activity, experimental stimulus/cue identities and recorded position/movement; evaluator arithmetic is reproducible conditional on authenticated source alignment.
scientific_target.case_unit: Complete session packet including neurons×frames and neuron×trial×60-position tensor; animal before/after contrast is the inferential case.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse mname grouped across all date/block sessions; regime comparisons resample animals independently within regime.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Observational, behavior-standardized stimulus selectivity on common support. Before/after and supervised-minus-unsupervised changes do not establish causal learning or reward mechanisms.
exclusions: No reward-specific inference from category2 alone or behavior-unmatched reward-location d-prime.
No cross-day tracked-cell identity, full source-figure reproduction or participant investigation grade.
No conditioning on unobserved arousal/licking/physical treadmill speed via ft_move alone.

inputs: Operator packet: calcium neurons×frames, cortical IDs, exact trial/stimulus identities, source position/movement, gray/corridor masks, source delayed-cue position and 60-bin position-interpolated activity.

For a future investigator, explicit permitted neural/behavioral observations and training reference data require separate packaging; current compound evaluator inputs include labels and are operator-only.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out animal/after-phase neural observations in fitting of the explanatory reference.
Undeclared cell registration, interpolated values treated as original independent frames, or source full-packet access used as a participant private-target route.
observation_contract.case_identity: session_manifest keys session_id,mname,datexp,blk,regime,phase must be unique and complete relative to supplied manifest; all declared mice require paired before/after phases. Actual native completeness remains unverified.
observation_contract.split: For descriptive contrasts, use all predeclared paired sessions and common movement-position support. Explanatory prediction holds every session of one mouse out and fits only before-phase sessions of other mice. Transductive behavioral matching is evaluator-side and is not candidate adaptation permission.
observation_contract.coverage: All supplied sessions, neurons and animals remain in denominators, with undefined support reported. Native figure-specific populations, safe interpolation identity and authentic full cohort have not been admitted.

primary.name: Common-support stimulus-selectivity change and supervised-minus-unsupervised animal contrast
primary.aggregation: Source arithmetic-SD d-prime for category2 versus0 on matched movement-position strata; fixed threshold regional fractions, session means within animal/phase, after−before per mouse and equal-mouse regime contrast.
primary.rationale: The endpoint is an estimated neural effect verified from observations, not agreement with a favored positive learning narrative. A future submission checker must verify numeric artifacts and stated uncertainty, without treating positive effects as answer correctness.

secondary: Source unmatched stimulus/reward-location d-prime fractions and moving-gray baseline activity, with matched coverage and undefined denominators.
Before-only leave-animal-out behavior-only versus stimulus-augmented ridge MSE, scaled MSE and complete held-out residuals.
Whole-trial stimulus null diagnostics within identical movement-position profiles, not calibrated p-values.

comparators.name: Behavior-only explanatory ridge
comparators.inputs: Position and source framewise movement; before-phase other-animal data only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only standardization and fixed ridge; equal animals/sessions/frames in training loss.

comparators.name: Stimulus-augmented explanatory ridge
comparators.procedure: Same held-animal and before-only fitting; retain all residuals, and treat amplitude calibration as unresolved.

comparators.name: Common-support and whole-trial null
comparators.inputs: Frozen joint movement/position strata and complete trial labels.
comparators.procedure: Implemented equal stratum weighting across every declared session/category; null permutes only exchangeable observed profiles, retaining fixed/nonexchangeable trials.

nuisance_controls: Separate raw stimulus, matched stimulus and unmatched reward-location endpoints; no reward-match claim from stimulus matching.
Source ft_move is VR position increment, not physical running speed; cue category does not guarantee reward delivery.
Freeze threshold/binning and neural amplitude calibration; never pair cells across sessions without registration.
evaluation.uncertainty: Animal bootstrap within regime for paired changes and independently across regimes for their difference; singleton/undefined animals prevent population intervals or complete estimates. Record coverage and retained biological denominators.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject inconsistent/missing sessions and arrays; zero dispersion d-prime and absent regions remain undefined without removing cells/animals. No common covariate support refuses the matched endpoint; no source narrative is substituted for missing truth.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluator.evaluate computes measured neural statistics and leave-animal-out predictions/residuals. There is no candidate answer/prediction submission API or independent investigation grader; it is an operator analysis/evaluator backend.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source-based numerical analysis and generated controls for mapped array packets; complete behavioral reward adjustment, authentic input bridge and participant evaluation are absent.
missing: Native cohort/session/cell/frame and60-bin interpolation authentication; source amplitude comparability.
Behavior-matched reward analysis or explicit removal from qualified claim, plus participant response schema and independent numerical-claim grading.
implementation.execution_evidence: Documented generated numerical/control tests only; no authentic cohort analysis, participant trial or empirical reproduction performed in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed direct interpretation of complete precomputed neural effect tables plus uncertainty could test evidence reading, but that is a separately defined representation.
direct_observation.boundary: Do not expose evaluator-computed answers while claiming inference from raw observations; freeze what is provided and what must be inferred.
missing: Non-answer-bearing direct observations and independently known response targets.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed cell/region/phase plots from permitted arrays; no viewer source exists.
typed_viewer.boundary: Keep observational selection fixed and avoid target-directed outcome filtering.
missing: Viewer, access limits and answer-grading contract.

tool_assisted.representation: Operator-only numerical source is present: Operator analysis backend computes selectivity, common-support contrasts, nulls and held-animal residuals. This does not deliver a participant-facing tool assisted mode.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current evaluator compound packets remain operator-only; a participant needs separate allowed views and no scoring feedback.
missing: Investigator transport, public/private split and submission-claim grader.

frozen_program.representation: Operator-only numerical source is present: Deterministic numerical analysis and frozen before-only explanatory reference. This does not deliver a participant-facing frozen program mode.
frozen_program.boundary: Fixed preprocessing/threshold/model choices before outcome access; no after-phase fitting or held-mouse leakage.
missing: External programme harness, authentic inputs and qualification.

summary: Narrow behavior-adjusted claim to the implemented common-support stimulus endpoint and preserve unmatched reward statistic as a companion limitation.
Separate an operator neural-analysis backend from a delivered participant investigation scorer.
Define answer truth as reproducible estimates with null/undefined outcomes and mouse-level uncertainty, not paper-conclusion agreement.
Keep operator analysis/reference APIs separate from participant-facing access: no delivered mode without its actual participant interface.
revision.source_review: Read source provenance, full numerical protocol, session_metrics/evaluate and matching/explanatory function structure; reused pinned author definitions.
